scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/schemas build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/registry build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/cli build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs tests/*.test.ts packages/*/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/schemas typecheck && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/registry typecheck && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/cli typecheck
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply deepseek-plugin-hub-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.db:seed:staging: wrangler d1 execute deepseek-plugin-hub-staging --env staging --remote --file scripts/seeds/community-plugins.sql
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging --compatibility-flag nodejs_compat
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env="" --compatibility-flag nodejs_compat
